entries.content: Great progress — 187 blog articles now! But traffic leaders (Shopify, Jingsourcing, Leeline, China Gate, Jota Fiuza) are blocked by Cloudflare. Instead: focus on expanding content from sources that WORK — amazing, nichedropshipping, junglescout. Also: run 'node scripts/quality-gate.js <file>' on each article before committing.

QUALITY GATE IS MANDATORY: Before marking any task done, run node scripts/quality-gate.js. This checks 9 criteria for GEO/AEO/SEO compliance. Grade A or B = done. Grade C or D = fix first. No exceptions.
